evidence: The sample pools r/investing, r/stocks, and r/StockMarket.
implication: Sentiment reflects selected finance-oriented Reddit communities, not all investors.

evidence: 79.6% of final Reddit posts occur in 2022.
implication: The corpus is concentrated in the crisis's central year.

evidence: 591 of 1,095 calendar days have no qualifying posts.
implication: Zero-post-day sentiment remains missing, not neutral.

evidence: Phase 7 uses 397-407 observations per market, retaining 52.7%-53.5% of finite-volatility rows.
implication: Inference pertains to the approved eligible samples rather than every finite-volatility trading day.

evidence: Eligibility requires nonmissing sentiment on the preceding aligned trading day.
implication: The regression sample is conditional on qualifying Reddit sentiment being observed.

evidence: The minimum attention_lag1 in every eligible sample is 1; no eligible row has zero prior-day attention.
implication: Attention measures discussion intensity conditional on discussion occurring, not zero versus positive discussion.

evidence: 2022 supplies 55.2%-55.5% of each market's estimation observations.
implication: The estimation samples are concentrated in 2022.

evidence: Predictors are lagged within the market trading calendar.
implication: Lagging variables does not establish structural causation.

evidence: ProsusAI/finbert is applied as a pretrained model without thesis-specific fine-tuning.
implication: The sentiment measure inherits the model's domain limits.

evidence: Point estimates differ, but no coefficient-equality test was part of the frozen design.
implication: The observed differences should not be described as formally established heterogeneity.
